newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Goldman Sachs to lead Brazil's Light global offer.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs to lead Brazil's Light global offer.

text.p: Goldman Sachs was awarded a contract to lead manage a global offering of a 28.8 percent stake in Brazil's Light -- the government's remaining stake in the power company, the National Development Bank (BNDES) said in a statement..
The outstanding government holdings in Light, worth one billion reais, are expected to be sold next year, BNDES said.
Other bidders for the contract were Merrill Lynch and Morgan Stanley do Brasil, it added.

Control of Light was sold in May to a group of investors made up of France's EDF, U.S. firms Houston Power Industries and AES Corp, Brazil's private steel mill CSN and BNDES Participacoes (BNDESPar), the investment wing of BNDES.
These investors collectively acquired 50.6 percent of Light's capital, with about another 10 percent going to minority investors. The company's employees also acquired 10 percent of the stock.
